subject: Meeting to discuss Q3 digital transformation roadmap
body:
Hi Atlas team,

I'd like to schedule a meeting next week to discuss our Q3 digital transformation roadmap. We're looking at Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon if anyone from the strategy team is available.

Could you also bring the latest progress report from the Phase 2 workstream?

Best regards,
David Chen
Head of Operations, Meridian Group

subject: Re: Pricing for digital transformation assessment
body:
Hi,

Thanks for the initial conversation last week. We're keen to move forward but need to understand the pricing structure before we can get budget approval.

Could you send over the costs for your assessment and strategy packages? We're a mid-market retailer with around 300 employees and 12 retail locations.

Also, do you offer any bundled pricing if we commit to both discovery and strategy phases?

Thanks,
Sarah Williams
CFO, BrightPath Retail

subject: Project status update needed - Northfield integration
body:
Hi team,

Our board meeting is this Friday and I need to present the current status of the ERP integration project. Could you provide:

1. Current completion percentage against the agreed milestones
2. Any blockers or risks we should be aware of
3. Updated timeline for the data migration phase

I'd appreciate a response by end of day Wednesday if possible.

Regards,
James Okonkwo
CTO, Northfield Engineering

subject: Disappointed with delayed deliverable - Phase 1 report
body:
Hi,

I'm writing to express my frustration with the Phase 1 assessment report. It was due on 23rd May and we still haven't received it. This is now 10 days overdue.

We have stakeholder commitments that depend on this report, and the delay is causing knock-on issues across our programme. This is the second time a deliverable has slipped on this engagement.

I need the completed report by end of this week at the latest, along with an explanation of why the deadline was missed.

Karen Frost
Programme Director, Lakeview Hotels Group

subject: Inquiry about your AI consulting services
body:
Hello,

I came across Atlas Professional Services through a recommendation from a colleague at Northfield Engineering. We're a logistics company based in Birmingham with around 180 staff and we're looking to explore how AI could improve our route planning and warehouse operations.

Could you tell me more about your services, how an engagement typically works, and what the first step would be?

We'd be happy to set up an introductory call at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Mohammed Ali
Managing Director, Crescent Logistics
